name: Zendesk
tagline: Customer service platform with AI agents
description: Zendesk brings email, messaging, phone and social conversations into one place, with AI agents for resolving service issues across channels.
features: Ticketing across email, messaging, phone and social
AI agents included in Suite and Support plans, billed by automated resolution
Copilot, Workforce Engagement and Contact Center add-ons
strengths: Clear per-agent plan prices with monthly and yearly options
A 14-day trial of the Suite Professional features and a startup programme are described
limitations: Priced per agent, and AI resolutions are billed on top of the included amount
Enterprise pricing is by talking to sales

pricing.trial: A 14-day trial with access to Suite Professional features; Zendesk for Startups offers a 6-month trial of the Suite for up to 50 agents for early-stage startups.

plans.name: Support Team
plans.billing: $25 per agent per month billed monthly; $19 billed yearly
highlights: 5 included automated resolutions per agent per month

plans.name: Suite Team
plans.billing: $69 per agent per month billed monthly; $55 billed yearly
highlights: 5 included automated resolutions per agent per month

plans.name: Suite Professional
plans.billing: $149 per agent per month billed monthly; $115 billed yearly
highlights: 10 included automated resolutions per agent per month

api.summary: AI agents are billed per automated resolution: $1.50 each when committed and $2.00 each pay-as-you-go, on all three listed plans.

pricing.regional: Prices were shown with a '$' sign and no code; the FAQ lists USD, EUR, GBP and BRL as supported currencies. The page says annual billing is 20% off.
